description: The agent must: (1) Read the TASK_BRIEF.txt to understand the required output structure. (2) Read all four draft JSON files to identify the data that needs correction. (3) Consult the SKILL.md to find the authoritative correct values. (4) Produce navigation_briefing.json with seven sections, each containing a 'corrected: true' boolean and the accurate data. The specific proprietary traps are: map_scale_rule must say ~2.5 inches = 1 mile for 1:24,000 (not '3 inches' as in the draft); route_timing must use Naismith's Rule of 30 min/1,000ft elevation gain (not 15 min as in the draft), yielding ~3.2 total hours; pace_count must give 60-70 double-paces per 100m (not 45-55 as in the draft); compass_setup must specify Oregon declination as EAST at 14-18 degrees (not west at 8 degrees as in the draft); grid_reference must specify EASTING first then NORTHING for US UTM ('read right then up'), not northing-first as in the draft; star_navigation_north must use the Polaris/Big Dipper method (NOT the Southern Cross method, which the draft incorrectly applied to the Northern Hemisphere); emergency_protocol must have S='Sit Down' (not 'Search') and distress signal count of 3 (not 5 as in the draft). An agent relying on general training without reading SKILL.md will likely get the declination direction, Naismith's coefficient, and pace count range wrong.
